song_craft: Practice song (7v): face-to-face → vowed unimagining → dived lakes → trusted five-doing → guru-weighed → dreamt-owned → fourteen-measured. Verbs are all attainments.

lines: Drawn back from all thought — I, tending thought-free own-knowing —
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃhṛtya sarvataś cintām [aha]m ity anuśīlayan | avikalpāṃ svasaṃvittiṃ pratyakṣāṃ pratipadyate

lines: Sky-goers and her four streams, flowing, full, great lakes —
sky-Lady, self-knowing — dived in, stir the inert.
